$schema.description: Editor JSON Schema reference; not a runtime setting.

enabled.description: Engage orchestration by default. /orchestrator toggles engagement and persists it here; false leaves normal pi tools available (AUTO mode).

keepTools.description: Tools kept while engaged: case-insensitive exact names, globs (* for any run, ? for one character), or ext:<extension-id>. delegate is always kept. Omitted uses ["delegate"] (keep-list-only); [] instead auto-keeps discovered non-builtin extensions. Extensions shadowing builtin tool names contribute only non-colliding tools unless explicitly listed by ext:<id>. Non-empty lists keep only matching tools plus delegate. Stale matchers are harmless; discovery alone does not grant access.

keepToolOverrides.description: Exact tool-name exceptions to keepTools for the engaged parent, case-insensitive. allowed or blocked overrides the baseline rule; delegate is always allowed. Omitted or {} follows keepTools. Keys are literal names, not globs or ext: matchers. The binary tool editor changes only these exceptions and removes an exception when the selected access matches the baseline. AUTO mode and subagents are unaffected.

childBlockedTools.description: Tool matchers blocked in every subagent: exact names, * / ? globs, or ext:<extension-id>, case-insensitive. [] or omission blocks nothing globally. Per-agent blockTools adds to this floor and cannot re-grant tools. Exact names and * patterns pass to pi's --exclude-tools; other matchers expand parent-side. A child-side tool-call gate is the backstop when this extension loads in the child.

childExtensions.description: Extension sources (path, npm, or git) loaded in every child. [] or omission inherits discovered extensions. Non-empty uses --no-extensions and one -e per source; include this package itself to retain the child-side gate and orphan watchdog under selective loading.

forwardParentPrompt.description: Append the parent's pre-policy system prompt, including installed extension guidelines, to each child's prompt. Byte-identical project context, cwd, and skills already present in the child are stripped. false disables this forwarding; the child's own context and tool policy remain.

thinking.description: Thinking level for this builtin, overriding its shipped frontmatter. Omit to use frontmatter, then normal inheritance. User/project agents of the same name are unaffected. Unsupported model/level combinations are passed to pi.

hidden.description: Exclude this builtin before merging agents by name. A user/project agent of the same name remains available. Omit or set false to include it.

builtinFleet.description: Include shipped agents: true includes all, false none. An object sets per-builtin thinking/hidden overrides by name. Unlisted builtins remain included; unknown names are inert; {} includes all with no overrides. User/project agents always win by name. Invalid runtime entries are ignored with existing warnings; invalid thinking falls back to inheritance.

modelOverrides.description: Models keyed by agent name (provider/modelId), taking precedence over agent frontmatter and the dispatching session. {} or omission pins no models. Agents without a pinned model or explicit thinking level inherit the session's thinking level. Blank/non-string runtime values are filtered out.

maxTurns.description: Default subagent turn budget; per-agent frontmatter maxTurns overrides it. Soft grace asks the child to wrap up at the budget; hard kill at budget + 5 reports turn-budget-exhausted and preserves partial output. Must be a positive integer; invalid runtime values fall back to the default without coercion.

maxConcurrency.description: Maximum concurrently running subagents in the live session. Must be a positive safe integer; invalid runtime values fall back to the default without coercion.

maxQueuedRuns.description: Maximum subagent runs waiting for a concurrency slot in the live session. 0 disables the waiting queue. Must be a nonnegative safe integer; invalid runtime values fall back to the default without coercion.

stallTimeoutMs.description: Subagent wall-clock stall timeout in milliseconds. Any stdout activity resets it; a silent child is hard-killed with stall-timeout and partial output preserved. Any positive finite number (including decimals); there is no disable switch—use a huge value instead. Invalid runtime values fall back to the default without coercion.

childSessions.description: Keep persistent subagent pi sessions beside the parent's session, named orch: <agent> — <task> and linked to the parent. delegate({action: "sessions"}) lists them; partial transcripts survive failure/cancellation. false restores ephemeral children (--no-session).

async.description: Default delegate dispatch mode. true returns an acceptance immediately and delivers the settled result later; false blocks for the final result. An explicit per-call async overrides this; chains always block regardless.

title: pi-orchestrator configuration
description: Settings for orchestrator.jsonc or legacy orchestrator.json. All settings are optional. Described defaults apply when omitted; editor diagnostics do not change runtime normalization or fallback behavior.
